sheets.name: cave_tiles
sheets.anchor: tile top-left; opaque unless listed in 'overlay'
sheets.description: Cave tileset, seamless vertically and horizontally. bg = dark blue/black rock (3 variants, identical borders so they mix freely). wall: wall_fill + inner edges for left (wall_l, wall_l_b) and right walls (wall_r, wall_r_b); the a/b edges stack in any order. platform: ground (top of a rock mass), floating ledge_l/m/r (1 tile thick, walkable top row 0), wall_l_ledge/wall_r_ledge (ledge growing out of a wall edge, joins ledge_m). pillar: stalagmite top (walkable, 6 cols wide) + repeatable body + base (sits on ground/ledge). ceil: underside of a rock mass (put under wall_fill/ground); ceil_stalactites = deco version. drip: ceiling tile with a stalactite and a forming/falling drop; pool: small water basin set into ground. crystal: glowing crystals standing on a surface. beam/lamp: mine support frame (beam_top has a post, lamp_* is a beam with a hanging lamp, beam_post repeats down). ladder: climbable rope ladder (repeats vertically). panel: carved sandstone tablet set into rock, hints the order sun-moon / eye-star when stacked. gate (4x5 tiles, 32x80): row 0 = gate_slot_sun, _moon, _eye, _star; rows 1-4 = gate_pillar_l, gate_door_l, gate_door_r, gate_pillar_r (repeat). gate_books = slot tiles with the matching book inserted; gate_open_l/r replace the two door columns.

sheets.name: cave_bats
sheets.description: Cave bat, black outline, faces right. fly = up/mid/down/glide flap loop; swoop = 2-frame dive toward the player.

sheets.name: cave_books
sheets.anchor: centre; book body cols 1-6 rows 2-14 incl. outline
sheets.description: Ancient book pickups (outlined), one tag each: sun = orange cover/yellow sun, moon = sky blue/white crescent, eye = green/white eye with red pupil, star = red/yellow star. Frame 1 idle, frame 2 shine glint.

sheets.name: cave_symbols
sheets.anchor: draw at the gate slot tile's top-left (same 8x16 grid)
sheets.description: Gate symbol plaques as overlays: the 6x7 plaque occupies cols 1-6 rows 2-8 of the slot tile. *_unlit matches the carving baked into gate_slot_* tiles; *_lit (2-frame pulse) is drawn when the right book is in that slot. No outline (inlay/glow).

sheets.name: cave_quake
sheets.anchor: tile top-left; opaque unless listed in 'overlay'
sheets.description: Earthquake/flood tiles. crack = wall_fill cracking open (one-shot, hold last frame; last frame seeps water). waterfall = vertical water stream over bg, loops and repeats vertically. flood_top = rising water surface with rolling waves (loops, repeats horizontally); flood = water body below it (static, seamless).

sheets.name: cave_quake_gush
sheets.anchor: crack origin at (1,4): place on the wall edge, mirror for right walls
sheets.description: Water gushing out of a wall crack, arcs right and falls; bright pens, no outline. Pair with a waterfall tile column under the landing point (about 12 cols right of the origin).

sheets.name: cave_quake_rock
sheets.description: Falling rock (outlined): fall = 4-frame tumble loop; break = split + pebbles on impact (one-shot).

notes: Vertical scroll bottom->top, 20-tile-wide shaft between the walls. Walkable surface = row 0 of ground, ledge_*, wall_*_ledge and pillar_top; leave 4 free tiles above a surface for the 64-row heroine and keep vertical steps <= 2 tiles, gaps <= 4 tiles. ceil/ceil_stalactites/drip only go directly under full rock (wall_fill or ground). bg_a/b/c and the a/b wall edges share identical borders, so mix them freely to break repetition. Book puzzle: the gate's top row holds 4 slots (sun, moon, eye, star). Inserting a book swaps gate_slot_X -> gate_book_X and draws cave_symbols X_lit (2-frame pulse) at the same tile position. When all 4 are in, swap the two door columns (rows 1-4) to gate_open_l/r, with a short screen shake. The panel tiles show the code order sun-moon / eye-star. Timing suggestions: drip loop 700 ms (the drop lands in a pool 3-5 tiles below); bat fly loop 320 ms, switch to swoop when the heroine is within ~6 tiles. Earthquake: shake the screen, play crack once on wall_fill tiles (850 ms, hold the last frame), then spawn cave_quake_gush at the wall edge next to the crack plus a waterfall column under its landing point. Rocks fall from the top every ~0.7 s and play break on impact. flood_top rises from the bottom (about 1 row every 2 frames), with flood tiles filling below it; switch the heroine to HEROINE_SWIM_FRAMES once she is submerged. mockup_cave uses the lead's Illuminati Excavator (levels/_chars/out/frames_cave_excavator.txt, mirrored to face the heroine): one mid-attack on the beam ledge, one walking on the floor. The heroine is shown with the climb frame from frames_actions.txt on the rope ladder (centre her body on the ladder tile column). cave_tiles has 47 tiles (14 are gate pieces); tile order is in tile_names.
